title: Make a vector
prompt: Return a Vector2 whose x is x and whose y is y. A Vector2 holds two numbers together, usually a position or a direction.
signature: func solve(x: float, y: float) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(x: float, y: float) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2.ZERO
hint: Vector2 is built by calling it with two values, like a function.
solution:
func solve(x: float, y: float) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(x, y)
